Actual for Q2FY27: Revenue – BEAT; EBITDA – INLINE; PAT – MISS Change in Estimates Post Q2FY27 FY27E/FY28E: Revenue: 8.3%/7.4%; EBITDA: -6.5%/0.0%; PAT: -7.9%/0.8% Recommendation Rationale • Strong CV Demand and Market Share Gains to Drive Growth: Ashok Leyland delivered strong volume growth in Q2FY27, supported by robust industry demand and improving replacement activity.
The domestic MHCV industry grew 39% YoY in Q2FY27, while Ashok Leyland's domestic MHCV volumes increased 44%, gaining 120bps market share to 32.1%, with truck market share improving 150bps.
Domestic LCV volumes grew 21% to 21,371 units, with VAHAN market share increasing 30bps to 13.6%.

watch: Sector Outlook: Positive Company Outlook & Guidance: Management expects double-digit to mid-teen FY27 growth across MHCV and LCV segments, supported by an ageing fleet, GST-led replacement demand, infrastructure spending and improving freight activity.
Product premiumisation, pricing actions, Rs 1,000-1,200 Cr cost savings and export recovery are expected to support profitability, while commodity inflation remains a near-term margin headwind.
